# Points & grids

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

5 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [HeatmapChart](#heatmapchart) · [TreemapChart](#treemapchart) · [ActivityGrid](#activitygrid) · [ScatterChart](#scatterchart) · [BubbleChart](#bubblechart)

## HeatmapChart

`heatmap-chart` · Labelled rows of values, normalised against `scaleMax`.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `HeatmapChart` | `SpHeatmapChart` | `sp-heatmap-chart` | `heatmap_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/heatmap-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/heatmap-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/heatmap-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `matrix`; intents `compare`, `distribution`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | yes |
| values | `valuesKey` | array | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "label": "Mon", "values": [ 12, 34, 58, 71, 66, 40 ] }, { "label": "Tue", "values": [ 18, 42, 77, 88, 70, 35 ] }, { "label": "Wed", "values": [ 9, 38, 64, 93, 81, 47 ] } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'label'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valuesKey` | `Accessor<readonly (number \| null)[] \| null \| undefined>` | `'values'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `scaleMax` | `number` | `100` | Value that maps to the darkest tone; 100 by default. |
| `columnLabels` | `readonly string[]` |  | Names of the columns, in order; missing ones fall back to `#k` (delta-006). |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { HeatmapChart } from '@silverpoint/react/heatmap-chart';

export function HeatmapChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <HeatmapChart
      data={rows}
      labelKey="label"
      valuesKey="values"
      title="Heatmap chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpHeatmapChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/heatmap-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpHeatmapChart
    :data="rows"
    labelKey="label"
    valuesKey="values"
    title="Heatmap chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpHeatmapChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/heatmap-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-heatmap-chart-view',
  imports: [SpHeatmapChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-heatmap-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [labelKey]="'label'"
      [valuesKey]="'values'"
      [title]="'Heatmap chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class HeatmapChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## TreemapChart

`treemap-chart` · Tiles of `cols × rows` cells placed in a `columns × rows` grid.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `TreemapChart` | `SpTreemapChart` | `sp-treemap-chart` | `treemap_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/treemap-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/treemap-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/treemap-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `parts`; intents `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | yes |
| share | `shareKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "label": "Search", "share": 48, "cols": 3, "rows": 4 }, { "label": "Direct", "share": 26, "cols": 3, "rows": 2 }, { "label": "Social", "share": 17, "cols": 2, "rows": 2 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'label'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `shareKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'share'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `columns` | `number` |  |  |
| `rows` | `number` |  |  |

## ActivityGrid

`activity-grid` · One cell per day, a column per week.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `ActivityGrid` | `SpActivityGrid` | `sp-activity-grid` | `activity_grid` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/activity-grid` | `@silverpoint/vue/activity-grid` | `@silverpoint/angular/activity-grid` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `events`; intents `schedule`, `trend`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| date | `dateKey` | date | yes |
| count | `countKey` | number | no |
| level | `levelKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "date": "2025-12-31", "count": 1, "level": 1 }, { "date": "2026-01-01", "count": 0, "level": 0 }, { "date": "2026-01-02", "count": 4, "level": 2 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dateKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'date'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `countKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'count'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `levelKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'level'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `weeks` | `number` | `26` | Weeks shown, the most recent last; 26 by default. |

## ScatterChart

`scatter-chart` · Points on two linear scales, optionally sized.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `ScatterChart` | `SpScatterChart` | `sp-scatter-chart` | `scatter_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/scatter-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/scatter-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/scatter-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `points`; intents `correlation`, `distribution`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
| y | `yKey` | number | yes |
| size | `sizeKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": 152, "y": 51, "size": 2 }, { "x": 158, "y": 56, "size": 4 }, { "x": 161, "y": 54, "size": 3 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `sizeKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `sizeRange` | `readonly [number, number]` | `[60, 240]` | Marker area in px², smallest to largest; `[60, 240]` by default. |

## BubbleChart

`bubble-chart` · Circles whose area encodes `sizeKey`.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `BubbleChart` | `SpBubbleChart` | `sp-bubble-chart` | `bubble_chart` |

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |

| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
